title: Feedback Request 1.0
description: Feedback to the makers from Tell the maker, forwarded to the Mayor: which kind it is, the screen he was on, his words and the build he sent it from. No photo unless he attaches one screenshot.

kind.description: add is 'Can I add this?' (a wish), wrong is 'Something's wrong' (a fault), other is a note that is neither.

screen.description: The screen he sent it from: Collection, Globe, Quarters, Learn or Settings.

text.description: What he wrote, in his words.

app_version.description: The Legend build he sent it from.
